Cube Storage Pioneers

Little Robots, Big Business

Since its inception in 1996, AutoStore™ has worked to improve warehouse efficiency. Today, the company’s key value proposition is to deliver an easy-to-use software powered cubic automatic storage and retrieval ecosystem.

The AutoStore solution is modular and flexible, and can automate any warehouse. The system offers a superior customer value proposition across operating metrics, ESG scores, and customer economics.

entry.title: Johann Reinhold Forster (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that John Beaglehole described the appointment of Johann Reinhold Forster (pictured with his son George) as naturalist on Cook's second voyage as "one of the Admiralty's vast mistakes"?

entry.title: Sanity Code (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the University of Virginia threatened to leave the National Collegiate Athletic Association in 1949 if the Sanity Code, which barred athletic scholarships, was not amended?

entry.title: Kit Nascimento (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Kit Nascimento, a spokesperson for the government of Guyana during the aftermath of Jonestown, disagrees with current proposals to open the former Jonestown site as a tourist attraction?

entry.title: an Oklahoma TV station (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the morning show on an Oklahoma TV station was such a "local phenomenon" that the president of ABC acquiesced to them not airing Good Morning America?

entry.title: Riko Dan (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Riko Dan, who featured on a UK Top 30 hit in 2024, first performed on the radio in 1994?

entry.title: a major water crisis in Richmond, Virginia (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that a blizzard across the United States caused a major water crisis in Richmond, Virginia?

entry.title: Antoinette Lubaki (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that it is said that Antoinette Lubaki, Congo's first named woman artist, painted her watercolours by candlelight at night, as no stories were allowed to be told during daylight?

entry.title: John Moores Painting Prize (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Graham Crowley entered the John Moores Painting Prize ten times since 1976 before finally winning in 2023?
